CBSE to hold special Class 12 exams for West Asia students

The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) will conduct special examinations in 40 subjects for Class 12 students in seven West Asian countries affected by the ongoing war crisis. These exams are for students whose board exams were cancelled due to the conflict. Students who are dissatisfied with results declared under a special assessment scheme can also appear for these exams without paying any fee. The application window for these exams is from September 22 to 26.
